records.question: Tổng giá trị hàng hóa (chưa tính phí ship, chưa trừ voucher) của các đơn hoàn thành trong năm 2025 theo giờ Việt Nam là bao nhiêu?
records.pred_sql:

    COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS total_merchandise_value
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts + INTERVAL 7 HOUR) = 2025;
records.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi USING(order_id) WHERE o.status='completed' AND YEAR(o.order_ts + INTERVAL 7 HOUR)=2025

records.question: Doanh thu hàng hóa của đơn hoàn thành theo từng tháng trong năm 2025 (giờ Việt Nam) và phần trăm tăng trưởng so với tháng liền trước, làm tròn 2 chữ số. Chỉ xét các tháng trong năm 2025 nên tháng 1 có tăng trưởng NULL. Cột tháng trả về dạng YYYY-MM.
records.pred_sql:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime(o.order_ts + INTERVAL 7 HOUR, '%Y-%m') AS month,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts + INTERVAL 7 HOUR) = 2025
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    month,
    revenue,
    ROUND((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS growth_rate
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month;
records.gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_ts + INTERVAL 7 HOUR) AS thang, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) AS dt FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi USING(order_id) WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY 1) SELECT thang, dt, ROUND(100.0*(dt - LAG(dt) OVER (ORDER BY thang))/LAG(dt) OVER (ORDER BY thang),2) AS tang_truong_pct FROM m WHERE YEAR(thang)=2025 ORDER BY thang

records.question: 5 danh mục con (trả về category_id và tên danh mục) có tiền hàng cao nhất trong các đơn hoàn thành.
records.pred_sql:
SELECT c.category_id, c.name_vi
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE c.parent_id IS NOT NULL
  AND o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name_vi
ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC
LIMIT 5;
records.gold_sql: SELECT c.category_id, c.name_vi, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id=p.category_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name_vi ORDER BY rev DESC, c.category_id LIMIT 5

records.question: Điểm đánh giá trung bình theo từng danh mục gốc (tên danh mục gốc), làm tròn 2 chữ số, xếp giảm dần.
records.pred_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS (
    SELECT category_id, name_vi AS root_category_name
    FROM categories
    WHERE parent_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.category_id, ct.root_category_name
    FROM categories c
    JOIN category_tree ct ON c.parent_id = ct.category_id
)
SELECT 
    ct.root_category_name,
    ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating
FROM reviews r
JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN category_tree ct ON p.category_id = ct.category_id
GROUP BY ct.root_category_name
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC;
records.gold_sql: SELECT r.name_vi, ROUND(AVG(rv.rating),2) AS avg_rating FROM reviews rv JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id=rv.order_item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id=p.category_id JOIN categories r ON r.category_id=c.parent_id GROUP BY r.name_vi ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, r.name_vi

records.question: Với mỗi danh mục gốc, 3 sản phẩm (product_id) bán nhiều nhất theo tổng quantity trong đơn hoàn thành. Nếu bằng nhau lấy product_id nhỏ hơn. Trả về tên danh mục gốc, product_id, tổng quantity.
records.pred_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE cat_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT category_id, category_id AS root_id, name_vi AS root_category_name
    FROM categories
    WHERE parent_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.category_id, ch.root_id, ch.root_category_name
    FROM categories c
    JOIN cat_hierarchy ch ON c.parent_id = ch.category_id
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        ch.root_category_name,
        oi.product_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ch.root_id 
            ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, oi.product_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM cat_hierarchy ch
    JOIN products p ON ch.category_id = p.category_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY ch.root_id, ch.root_category_name, oi.product_id
)
SELECT 
    root_category_name,
    product_id,
    total_quantity
FROM product_sales
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY root_category_name, rn;
records.gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT r.name_vi AS root, p.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id=p.category_id JOIN categories r ON r.category_id=c.parent_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY r.name_vi, p.product_id), k AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY root ORDER BY qty DESC, product_id) AS rn FROM s) SELECT root, product_id, qty FROM k WHERE rn<=3 ORDER BY root, qty DESC, product_id

records.question: Tỉ lệ phần trăm đơn bị hoàn trả (returned) trên các đơn đã giao xong (completed + returned) theo từng danh mục gốc; đếm theo đơn (một đơn có nhiều danh mục thì tính cho từng danh mục), làm tròn 2 chữ số.
records.pred_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE cat_root AS (
    SELECT category_id, category_id AS root_category_id, name_vi AS root_category_name
    FROM categories
    WHERE parent_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.category_id, cr.root_category_id, cr.root_category_name
    FROM categories c
    JOIN cat_root cr ON c.parent_id = cr.category_id
),
order_root_categories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cr.root_category_id,
        cr.root_category_name,
        o.order_id,
        o.status
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN cat_root cr ON p.category_id = cr.category_id
    WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'returned')
)
SELECT
    root_category_id,
    root_category_name,
    ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'returned' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM order_root_categories
GROUP BY root_category_id, root_category_name
ORDER BY root_category_id;
records.gold_sql: SELECT r.name_vi, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status='returned' THEN o.order_id END)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) AS ty_le FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id=p.category_id JOIN categories r ON r.category_id=c.parent_id WHERE o.status IN ('completed','returned') GROUP BY r.name_vi ORDER BY ty_le DESC, r.name_vi

records.question: Với các đơn hoàn thành, tổng tiền hàng và tổng phí ship theo từng hãng vận chuyển (bảng shipments). Trả về carrier, tổng tiền hàng, tổng phí ship.

    SELECT
        order_id,
        SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total_goods_amount
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
    s.carrier,
    SUM(og.total_goods_amount) AS total_goods_amount,
    SUM(o.shipping_fee) AS total_shipping_fee
FROM orders o

GROUP BY s.carrier;
records.gold_sql: WITH g AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity*unit_price) AS goods FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT s.carrier, SUM(g.goods) AS tien_hang, SUM(o.shipping_fee) AS phi_ship FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id JOIN g ON g.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY s.carrier

records.question: Tổng số tiền giảm giá từ voucher của các đơn hoàn thành trong năm 2025 (giờ Việt Nam). Voucher percent giảm tiền hàng * value / 100 (làm tròn xuống đồng), voucher fixed giảm đúng value đồng, và mức giảm không vượt quá tiền hàng của đơn.
records.pred_sql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(
        LEAST(
            og.item_total,
            CASE
                WHEN v.discount_type = 'percent' THEN CAST(FLOOR(og.item_total * v.value / 100.0) AS BIGINT)
                WHEN v.discount_type = 'fixed' THEN v.value
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
    ), 0) AS total_voucher_discount
FROM orders o
JOIN vouchers v ON o.voucher_id = v.voucher_id
JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS item_total
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
) og ON o.order_id = og.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts + INTERVAL 7 HOUR) = 2025;
records.gold_sql: WITH g AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity*unit_price) AS goods FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUM(LEAST(CASE WHEN v.discount_type='percent' THEN CAST(FLOOR(g.goods*v.value/100.0) AS BIGINT) ELSE v.value END, g.goods)) FROM orders o JOIN g ON g.order_id=o.order_id JOIN vouchers v ON v.voucher_id=o.voucher_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND YEAR((o.order_ts + INTERVAL 7 HOUR))=2025

records.question: Với khách ở Hà Nội và khách ở TP. Hồ Chí Minh (gộp mọi cách ghi tên của hai thành phố này): số khách có ít nhất 1 đơn hoàn thành và tổng tiền hàng của họ từ các đơn hoàn thành. Trả về tên chuẩn ('Hà Nội' hoặc 'TP. Hồ Chí Minh'), số khách, tổng tiền hàng.
records.pred_sql:
WITH normalized_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN regexp_matches(province, '(?i)(hà nội|ha noi|hanoi|\bhn\b)') THEN 'Hà Nội'
            WHEN regexp_matches(province, '(?i)(hồ chí minh|ho chi minh|\bhcm\b|tphcm|tp\.hcm|sài gòn|sai gon)') THEN 'TP. Hồ Chí Minh'
        END AS province_name
    FROM customers
)
SELECT 
    nc.province_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT nc.customer_id) AS customer_count,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_sales
FROM normalized_customers nc
JOIN orders o ON nc.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE nc.province_name IS NOT NULL
  AND o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY nc.province_name;

Hồ Chí Minh' WHEN province IN ('Hà Nội','HN','Ha Noi','Hanoi') THEN 'Hà Nội' ELSE province END AS prov FROM customers), g AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity*unit_price) AS goods FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT n.prov, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS so_khach, SUM(g.goods) AS tien_hang FROM orders o JOIN n ON n.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN g ON g.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND n.prov IN ('Hà Nội','TP. records.question: Trung vị (median) tiền hàng của một đơn hoàn thành đặt trong năm 2025 (giờ Việt Nam), làm tròn 0 chữ số.
records.pred_sql:
WITH order_subtotal AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS subtotal
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts + INTERVAL 7 HOUR) = 2025
    GROUP BY o.order_id
)
SELECT ROUND(MEDIAN(subtotal), 0) AS median_merchandise_value
FROM order_subtotal;

records.question: Tiền hàng trung bình của một dòng sản phẩm (quantity * unit_price) trong order_items theo từng danh mục gốc (tên danh mục gốc), làm tròn 0 chữ số, tính trên tất cả các dòng.
records.pred_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        category_id AS root_id,
        name_vi AS root_name,
        category_id
    FROM categories
    WHERE parent_id IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        ct.root_id,
        ct.root_name,
        c.category_id
    FROM categories c
    JOIN category_tree ct ON c.parent_id = ct.category_id
)
SELECT 
    ct.root_name,
    ROUND(AVG(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS avg_item_amount
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN category_tree ct ON p.category_id = ct.category_id
GROUP BY ct.root_id, ct.root_name;
records.gold_sql: SELECT rc.name_vi, ROUND(AVG(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price), 0) AS tb FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id=p.category_id JOIN categories rc ON rc.category_id=c.parent_id GROUP BY rc.name_vi
